messages:
maria: Heads-up: console preview sampling vs final invoice mismatch for tenant `acme-inc`. Preview shows ~2.3M tokens, invoice shows ~2.05M. Spotted this after the sampling rollout last night.
jack: Which sampling config was rolled? cc @kate-console
maria: We flipped route_sampling for streaming routes from 0.02 -> 0.01 around 01:10 UTC. Preview pipeline uses sample-card v2, finalizer still on v1 for edge routes.
lee: oh nice catch. I thought we switched both in the canary.
samir-billing: From billing side: when we rehydrate sampled events we apply scale factors; if sampling probability changes mid-window you'll see sticky discrepancies.
kate-console: investigating. I see preview joins on `sample_id` while invoice finalizer uses `route_id` enrichment. Possible join-key mismatch + clamp behavior.
nina-product: :eyes: impact estimate? Is this customer-facing?
maria: Looks limited — only tenants hitting streaming-route-legacy (about 10 tenants) affected. We see ~10% lower invoice compared to preview for those.
lee: Quick repro steps: `curl -H 'X-Tenant: acme-inc' "https://console.preview.internal/usage?since=2026-03-19T00:00"` — I can reproduce locally, attaching a small log snippet.
maria: logs: 
```
SAMPLE_SET=preview_v2
route_sampling=0.01
applied_scale=100
```
Preview pipeline emitted scale=100, finalizer used scale=95.
samir-billing: Scale computation is `scale = 1.0 / sampling_prob` but we also have a legacy clamp at 100. If preview used unclamped value and finalizer applied clamp (or vice-versa) you'll get drift. Also mid-window sampling flips can cause rounding differences when we aggregate.
kate-console: I can patch preview to use the legacy clamp until finalizer is bumped. That should align numbers quickly. @lee you'll need to redeploy preview-join.
lee: I can rollback/redeploy in ~20m. Need sign-off to rollback the canary. Any objections?
nina-product: Do it, but please slack CS + affected tenants after we confirm.
maria: Also adding an alert for sampling-probability drift >2% across preview vs finalizer pipelines. Filed: https://go/alerts/SMPL-DRIFT (quick rule).
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-20260320-32: sampling-probability-inconsistency
samir-billing: After rollback, we'll run a reconciliation job to recompute invoices for the 48h window if delta > 5%. I'll coordinate with finance ops.
maria: :thumbsup: thanks — I'll draft the customer note and changelog entry.
kate-console: Opening PR to unify sampling config code paths and add unit tests for clamp behavior and join keys. Will link soon.
lee: starting rollback now (kube rollout restart deployment/preview-join).
maria: rollback complete at 1732100299; monitoring dashboards now. Will post a follow-up once reconciliation plan is scheduled.
